description: This file defines the interface for hash lookup operations, including functions to search for object IDs and hashes within a table, utilizing fanout tables and binary search algorithms.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Finds the position of an object ID within a table using a specified access function.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a hash in a table, utilizing a fanout table for interval determination.

ctags.name: oid_access_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef const struct object_id *oid_access_fn(size_t index, const void *table);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:const struct object_id * ()(size_t index,const void * table)
